subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He enrolled in the Islamia college, a well-respected college affiliated to the University of Calcutta. (b) Mujib became politically active when he joined the All India Muslim federation in 1940. (c) He returned to school after four years owing to the seventy of the surgery and show recovery. (d) Two years later he took admission in class four at Madaripur Islamia High school. (e) In 1929, Mujib entered into class three at Gopalganj public school. (f) However, Mujib was with drawn from school in 1934 to undergo eye surgery. (g) Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was born in Tungipara, a village in Gopalganj District.
